science.explanation: The Panopticon Synthesis Interface is a novel approach to designing and optimizing electronic systems. By leveraging advanced algorithms and machine learning techniques, this interface enables users to synthesize complex electronic circuits with unprecedented efficiency.
assumptions: The user has a basic understanding of electronic circuit design and analysis
The system has access to a large dataset of pre-optimized circuit designs
